summary.overview: Introduction to the OSI reference model, its purpose, and the benefits of layering in computer networks
main_points: The OSI model has 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, and Application
Each layer has its own set of functionalities and interacts with adjacent layers
The order of the layers is important and can be remembered using the sentence 'Please do not throw sausage pizza away'
Intermediary nodes in a network only process data from the Physical, Data Link, and Network layers
action_items: Remember the correct order of the OSI layers
Understand how each layer interacts with other layers
Apply the concept of layering to real-world networking scenarios
Complete the activity to identify the correct order of the OSI layers
